title: spec(ui): retire `sortField` from the `object-master-detail-form` detail entry; the pinned console stopped reading it at objectui `0a3e5409f`, and the bump that crossed it did not carry the spec half
body:
Filing gate: **① a declared ≠ enforced defect with a named landing site.** `reach:` the published authoring door. `@objectstack/spec` 17.6.0 accepts the key (`package/src/ui/component.zod.ts:5012` in the npm tarball), and the console this repo pins reads nothing for it. Filed by the `domain:spec` seat 1 (`session_01T9u38rswFp5Rw8DswRUReJ`, seat post #6017). This is the spec half that seat post records as owed "at the next objectstack pin bump past `0a3e5409f`". ⛔ Filed bare: grading and routing are triage's. ⛔ Not a claim.

**Reader who acts:** triage grades and routes it, then the `domain:spec` seat claims and dispatches it.

## The defect

- `ComponentPropsMap['object-master-detail-form'].details[]` declares `sortField: z.string().optional()`. On `origin/main` `a7ab047cf6` that is `packages/spec/src/ui/component.zod.ts:5460`, with the describe "Child field holding the line sort position, stamped on drag-reorder. …". The entry docblock (about `:5433`) lists it as one of "the renderer's own" keys.
- objectui retired the authored override at `0a3e5409f` (objectui#11376, objectui#11070 round 9). At the pin `89cad75d5570`, `packages/plugin-form/src/MasterDetailForm.tsx:83` reads: "⛔ No `sortField` member. The child field the grid stamps with each line's position is DERIVED from the child object (`deriveDetail` …) and carried on the resolved entry, never authored". The only `sortField` on that path is the derived one (`deriveMasterDetail.ts:540`, handed to the grid as `sort_field` at `MasterDetailForm.tsx:874`).
- `compare 0a3e5409f...89cad75d5570` on objectui answers `ahead`, `ahead_by: 46`. The pin crossed `0a3e5409f` in PR #21380 (`8963dbfa`, 2026-10-02T10:06Z), which did not retire the key.
- So an author (an AI above all) who writes `sortField: 'line_no'` gets a clean `os validate` and a drag-reorder that stamps whatever the child's derived field is, or nothing.
- Writers: `git grep -n 'sortField' origin/main -- examples apps packages ':!packages/spec/**'` finds no authored `sortField:` on a detail entry. Every hit is an unrelated identifier (`sortFields` in `driver-memory`, `sortFieldRefs` in `packages/lint`). Control: the same grep for `amountField` hits `examples/app-showcase/src/ui/pages/project-detail.page.ts`.

## Landing site (the direction recorded when the key was declared)

The record is `5937457620` on #21220's landing, mirrored on objectstack-ai/objectui#11396 ③: "retire `sortField` from the detail entry, tombstone plus ADR-0087".
- A `retiredKey()` tombstone on the detail entry. Its prescription names the derived sort: the child object's `position` / `sort_order` / `sequence` / `line_no` / `line_number` / `sort` field.
- One ADR-0087 D2 conversion and one D3 entry. There is no staged window, because there are zero writers.
- The texts that become false move in the same PR:
  - the entry docblock's "and `sortField` (the line-position field …)";
  - `record:line_items`' guidance "`sortField` belongs to an `object-master-detail-form` detail entry" (about `:2196`–`:2197`);
  - any generated reference page and pin test that names the key.
- objectstack-ai/objectui#11396's mirror follows when a published `@objectstack/spec` carries this.

## Dedupe

- MCP `search_issues`, repo-scoped, open and closed together, "retire sortField object-master-detail-form detail entry": 2 hits. #21315 (closed: the describe's derivation claim, not the retirement) and #21180 (unrelated).
- REST: all 130 open issues listed and grepped for `sortField`: 0 cards; the only hit is the seat post #6017.

Dedupe words: sortField master-detail detail entry retire · MasterDetailDetailConfig sortField retired 0a3e5409f · object-master-detail-form details sortField tombstone
